title: Paz Palace
geometryBasis: Named building relation and connected entry footprint locate the street façades, corner, side bow, short returns and the small open light court.
sectionBasis: The exact June 1916 photograph establishes façade orders, mansards, curved corner, dormers and cornices. The Argentine listing identifies the sculpted principal front and lower gate.
limitations: The main three wings and low entrance are represented. The separate sports pavilion and modern hotel remain separate from this building.
Exact relief sculpture, back elevation openings and roof heights are approximations. The ground data are interpolated from the original one-metre interval contours.
